why.portta: Part of Portta. Removing it could take the panel or the gateway down.
why.in-use: A container still uses it (running or stopped). Remove the container first.

selectAll: Select everything that can be removed
lockedName: {{name}} is protected and cannot be selected

networks.footnote: Select all leaves out Portta's networks, Docker's defaults and any a container still uses. Removing the network of a stopped project keeps it from starting until the network is recreated.

confirm.effect: A project that used the network recreates it the next time it starts.

images.title: Images
images.uniqueHint: Removing frees {{size}}: the rest is shared with other images
images.footnote: Select all follows the current filter and leaves out Portta's images and any a container was created from. The size shown is the whole image; removing frees only what other images do not share.

confirm.effect: A removed image is pulled or built again the next time a container needs it.

volumes.title: Volumes
volumes.footnote: A volume is data, often a database, and it does not come back. Select all leaves out Portta's volumes and any a container mounts, stopped or not.

confirm.effect: What is inside them is erased from disk and cannot be recovered.

maintenance.title: Maintenance

plan.title: What to clean
plan.description: A cleanup removes only what nothing uses. Portta, Docker's default networks and anything a container references always stay.
plan.containersHint: Those that finished or never started. Portta's components stay. Frees the networks, images and volumes they were holding.
plan.networksHint: Networks of projects that were already removed.
plan.imagesHint: Unused is every image no container was created from, and it is pulled again when somebody needs it.
plan.volumesHint: Anonymous ones are those Docker named for a container. Named ones are usually databases.
plan.volumesWarning: Unused named volumes are usually the database of a project that was removed. Deleting them cannot be undone.

preview.nothing: There is nothing to remove with these choices.

maintenance.buildCache: The build cache takes {{size}} and the panel does not clean it. On the server:

confirm.effect: Each item is removed one by one; what cannot go is listed afterwards.
confirm.withVolumes: This cleanup deletes named volumes, with what is inside them. Each item is removed one by one; what cannot go is listed afterwards.
